p, k = map(int, input().split())

def getroot(parent, u):
    while parent[u] != u:
        parent[u] = parent[parent[u]]
        u = parent[u]
    return u

def merge(parent, size, u, v):
    u = getroot(parent, u)
    v = getroot(parent, v)
    if u != v:
        size[u] += size[v]
        parent[v] = u

def isok(a, b, p):
    res = 1
    while b > 0:
        if b & 1:
            res = res * a % p
        a = a * a % p
        b >>= 1
    return p if res == 1 else 1

def binpow(a, b):
    res = 1
    while b > 0:
        if b & 1:
            res = res * a % 1000000007
        a = a * a % 1000000007
        b >>= 1
    return res

if k == 0:
    print(binpow(p, p - 1))
else:
    parent = list(range(p))
    size = [1] * p
    for i in range(p):
        v = (k * i) % p
        merge(parent, size, v, i)

    answer = 1
    for i in range(p):
        if getroot(parent, i) == i:
            answer = (answer * isok(k, size[i], p)) % 1000000007

    print(answer)
